tasks.prompt: movie composition, 2.35:1 Flat vector illustration, sticker style with thick white outlines. A glowing purple folder icon in the center of the frame, labeled with a small star symbol. Three colorful translucent arrows radiate outward from the folder: one electric blue arrow pointing upper-right to a terminal window icon, one warm orange arrow pointing right to a code editor icon, one teal arrow pointing lower-right to a command-line prompt icon. Each target icon is rendered as a semi-transparent ghost outline, implying they are references not copies. Clean white background, minimal geometric shapes, modern tech aesthetic. Color palette: deep purple center, electric blue, warm orange, teal accents. No text, no characters.
